children: NeuPath Health Inc. (TSXV:NPTH), (“NeuPath” or the “Company”), operates one of Canada’s largest networks of community-based, multidisciplinary medical facilities focused on the assessment and treatment of chronic pain, musculoskeletal/back pain, sports medicine and other pain-related medical services, is pleased to announce the Company is participating in the upcoming 2026 Smallcap Discoveries Conference in Vancouver and Planet Microcap Toronto 2026. Management will present an overview of the Company's business, recent operational and financial milestones, growth strategy and outlook.
Parq Hotel & Casino, Vancouver, British Columbia
Investors interested in registering for the conference or meeting with NeuPath at the Smallcap Discoveries Conference may register
Investors interested in registering for the conference or meeting with NeuPath at Planet MicroCap Toronto may register

NeuPath operates one of Canada’s largest networks of community-based, multidisciplinary medical facilities focused on the assessment and treatment of chronic pain, musculoskeletal/back pain, sports medicine and other pain-related medical services. NeuPath provides improved access to care and outcomes for patients by leveraging best-in-class treatments and delivering patient-centered multidisciplinary care. Working within Canada’s publicly funded healthcare system, NeuPath delivers insured medical services to help extend the appropriate care from hospitals into the community, which are complemented by select non-insured procedures to provide a comprehensive and coordinated treatment for patients. For additional information, please visit www.neupath.com.
